data.body: **[P1] Pass the checked-out release SHA, not the mutable tag.** The Maven job resolves this tag during its initial checkout, while the layer workflow resolves it again later. If the tag moves to another same-version commit, the layer and Maven/GitHub artifacts come from different sources while existing checks still pass. Export `git rev-parse HEAD` immediately after release checkout and pass that SHA as `source_ref`, also verifying the tag still resolves to it.
